Nodes.Speaker: Innkeep
Nodes.Text: The Hound keeps a bed. What brings you to {town}?

Options.Label: I carry a letter about a relic.

Nodes.Speaker: Innkeep
Nodes.Text: A letter, is it? The old one by the hearth spoke of a Totem sleeping in a vault at {dungeon}. Take it — and mind which hall you give it to.

Nodes.Speaker: Innkeep
Nodes.Text: A locked vault in {dungeon}. The watch does not go there. Neither should you, unless you mean to.

Nodes.Speaker: Innkeep
Nodes.Text: The road is long. Hunger walks with you. The gate shuts after dusk.
